archetypes.name: dyn-oos-cap-evidence
archetypes.rationale: Verify capped/combined OOS rollup records every source stable ID so retries do not re-file the rolled-up remainder.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on python/oos_filer.py _stable_ids_by_combined_item and the _file call site that now reads the post-cap combined file after issue_cap. Confirm the index->stable-id mapping covers every source stable ID across cap=1 (full rollup into one aggregate), cap>1 (partial rollup where the last block aggregates the tail), and codex-combine cases, so no source block is orphaned. Trace how source_stable_ids flow into _write_sentinel and _write_oos_ndjson, then back through _split_persisted_matches/_issue_covers_stable_id on a retry, checking the aggregate issue's recorded evidence prevents re-filing the remainder. Watch for off-by-one in the tail slice blocks[combined_count-1:] and any index mismatch between post-cap block indices and the original source blocks. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
